title: Kelvo worker on Oracle E2.1.Micro: b1a0ea5 runtime, matched r2 campaign
scope: Worker-only accounting. Azure gateway, three NATS brokers, ClickHouse source and all SSH tunnels are excluded. Does not certify whole-cluster fit or later runtime changes.

source_fixture_correction.scope: Disposable source user profile only; compiled runtime and source server configuration unchanged.

host.observation_scope: Read-only observation during the running capacity campaign
host.machine_scope: Oracle Cloud VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro worker host; fractional CPU entitlement, not two dedicated cores

control_plane_host.observation_scope: Read-only observation during the running capacity campaign
control_plane_host.machine_scope: Source database, gateway, NATS and client host

conditions.cache_scope: Reference queries precede preflight and measured workloads. Source and OS caches are not flushed or otherwise controlled.
conditions.worker_lifecycle: Fresh owned worker/observer service for each profile, followed by 35 seconds for the old lease; same frozen binary/config/input identities.
conditions.transport: Azure client and verified TLS gateway; Oracle worker; three supervised SSH transport processes; native source on Azure. Query submission, dispatch and full Arrow response are timed; value comparison follows outside timing.
conditions.competing_work: No other agent builds or tests were scheduled on either benchmark host during this campaign; uncontrolled provider scheduling remains visible in host steal observations.
conditions.accounting_scope: Worker service cgroup includes observer and disposable children, excludes source/gateway/NATS/SSH. RSS shared pages may be counted more than once; source/host cache ownership affects cgroup charges.

campaign.timestamp_scope: Start derived from durable expiry minus the fixed 6000-second campaign window; finish is local final receipt persistence after controller cleanup.

resources.sampling_scope: RSS: observed node and worker processes across delegated descendants. Cgroup: node, disposable children and Python observer; excludes source, gateway, NATS and SSH. Shared RSS pages can be counted twice; sampling can miss short peaks.

client.timing_scope: Submission through complete Arrow response at the Azure client; SQL, dispatch, verified TLS and Oracle-Azure SSH transport included. Value decoding is outside timing. Source/gateway/NATS/SSH resources excluded from separate Oracle node cgroup.

summary.scope: One executor, three serial queries then ten concurrent queued submissions per profile. Service cgroup includes observer; source, gateway, NATS and SSH excluded. Sample p95 is nearest rank, not a confidence bound.

source.scope: Container identity, image, start time, CPU/RAM allocation and table row metadata; not a full content checksum.

independent_review.scope: Independent post-campaign SSH read-only inspection. Source preservation covers container identity, image, start time, allocation and table row metadata, not full content checksums.

limitations: Repeated narrow results are not distinct source rows.
Ten concurrent submissions use one execution permit; this is queued concurrency.
Warm uncontrolled caches and variable fractional CPU/steal limit cross-run comparisons.
RSS can double-count shared pages; cgroup cache charges may belong to earlier groups.
These observations do not establish minimum production RAM, SLA or causal metrics savings.
